stemMarkdown: Evaluate $\dfrac{1}{6 + \sqrt{7}}$ as a decimal. (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Multiply top and bottom by the conjugate $6 - \sqrt{7}$: $\dfrac{6 - \sqrt{7}}{6^2 - 7} = \dfrac{6 - \sqrt{7}}{29} = 0.115664$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Rationalising does not change the value — it just moves the irrational part to the numerator.
